span.p:
STAGE 1 - MLM PRETRAINING
elDORS 1.32B + RNAcentral 46M
WEIGHTED per chunk: 9 of 20 chunks have
median length exactly 151 nt (raw reads).
Uniform sampling would let fragments dominate.
Chunks 6 and 9 (median 2193-2389 nt) are the
only real long-context signal.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
STAGE 2 - SECONDARY STRUCTURE
bpRNA-1m, bpRNA-spot, ArchiveII,
RNAStrAlign, bpRNA-new
~160k annotations

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
STAGE 3 - MOTIF BANK INIT
BGSU Motif Atlas 4.12
4992 instances to 667 classes
bank computed then FROZEN

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
STAGE 4 - MULTI-TASK 3D
RNA3DB 15441 + gRNAde 12011
contacts + Mg2+ sites + rigidity
Mg2+ and B-factor labels extracted
from mmCIF at zero marginal cost

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
STAGE 5 - ION-CONDITIONED REFINEMENT
structures stratified by ionic condition
RISK: mmCIF records crystallisation
conditions inconsistently - AUDIT FIRST

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
STAGE 6 - 3D DECODER
frame diffusion, RNA3DB documented split

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CRITICAL DATA GAP
Chemical probing NOT in catalog.
Ribonanza = 2.1M sequences with DMS+SHAPE
= 315x more supervised examples than the
6661 unique sequences with 3D.
HIGHEST-PRIORITY ACQUISITION.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
EVALUATION - BLIND ONLY
CASP15 (15), CASP16 (10), RNA-Puzzles
held out entirely.
Sequence-identity dedup MANDATORY:
5S rRNA alone is 5976 of the BGSU clusters,
so a random split is meaningless.
Field ceiling is TM ~0.55 (trRosettaRNA 0.548).
